description: This file contains implementation of helper functions for generating time domain resource configurations related to 5G NR scheduling, including candidate generation for K1, calculation of minimum PDSCH symbols, and generation of dedicated PDSCH and PUSCH time domain resource lists, with support for TDD and FDD configurations.

classes.name: time_domain_resource_helper
classes.description: Namespace containing helper functions for time domain resource configuration in 5G NR scheduling.

methods.name: generate_k1_candidates
methods.description: Generates a list of candidate k1 values based on TDD UL/DL configuration, prioritizing low latency.

methods.name: calculate_minimum_pdsch_symbol
methods.description: Calculates the minimum OFDM symbol index for PDSCH transmission considering CORESET and search space configurations.

methods.name: generate_dedicated_pdsch_td_res_list
methods.description: Generates a list of PDSCH time domain resource allocations based on TDD configuration and minimum symbol index.

methods.name: generate_dedicated_pusch_td_res_list
methods.description: Generates a list of PUSCH time domain resource allocations based on TDD configuration and minimum k2 value.
